description: The one card of a tracked change, shared by the revision panel and the suggestion panel (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 6, DE-2.4): the author's avatar (initials without a picture), the type of the change as title with an icon and an accent from the success / danger / info tokens, 'author - relative time' through the shared ITmRelativeTimeFormatter, the preview (an ins for an insertion, a del for a deletion, a plain line otherwise) and compact Accept / Reject buttons. The type is always worded, so the accent never carries it alone.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: The type of the change; drives the icon, the accent and the ins / del of the preview.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The localized type of the change.

parameters.name: AuthorName
parameters.description: The author's display name.

parameters.name: AuthorId
parameters.description: Stable author key that picks the avatar colour.

parameters.name: AuthorAvatarUrl
parameters.description: Optional avatar picture.

parameters.name: CreatedAt
parameters.description: When the change was made; rendered relative with the absolute time in the tooltip.

parameters.name: Preview
parameters.description: What the card shows of the change.

parameters.name: FallbackText
parameters.description: The localized line shown when the preview has nothing to show.

parameters.name: Selected
parameters.description: Whether this is the selected card.

parameters.name: ActionsDisabled
parameters.description: Whether Accept and Reject are disabled.

parameters.name: ClassPrefix
parameters.description: BEM block of the host panel; the card keeps wearing its element classes.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised when the card is pressed.

parameters.name: OnAccept
parameters.description: Raised by Accept.

parameters.name: OnReject
parameters.description: Raised by Reject.

parameters.name: AcceptLabel
parameters.description: Visible text of the Accept button.

parameters.name: RejectLabel
parameters.description: Visible text of the Reject button.

parameters.name: AcceptAriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the Accept button (it names the author).

parameters.name: RejectAriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the Reject button (it names the author).

parameters.name: PreviewTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the preview line.

parameters.name: AcceptTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the Accept button.

parameters.name: RejectTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the Reject button.
